description.value: HIENet was trained on the MPtrj dataset (1.58M crystal structures) with a 95%/5% train/validation split for 250 epochs using the AdamW optimizer with cosine annealing learning rate schedule. The loss function combines Huber losses for energy, force, and stress predictions with weights λE=1.0, λF=1.0, λσ=0.01. An exponential moving average (EMA) of model parameters with decay 0.999 was maintained.
